introHtml: Raglan baseball shirts bring a classic, sporty look to your office wardrobe, making them ideal for casual Fridays, company outings, or team-building events. Unlike standard button-downs or polos, the contrasting sleeves and relaxed fit create a unified, approachable feel that stands out. Decorate with your logo or employee names using screen printing or embroidery for a polished finish. These shirts work well for businesses that want a comfortable yet professional uniform option.
